verdict.rationale: Airweave hosts a working llms.txt at docs.airweave.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with explicit instructions for AI agents, plus .md-suffixed clean markdown versions of every doc page, confirming agent-oriented documentation is a first-class, deliberate design choice. Missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation that agents actually consume and act on the llms.txt file in practice.
